purpose: Defines which actors and scripts are responsible for each doc-link process, their write permissions and prohibitions, logical script operations, Skill-script connection rules, and managed-state storage.
summary: Responsibility table for project AI, Skill, deterministic scripts, information-generating AI, search AI, and user, with write permissions
Logical script operations with inputs, success results, and side-effect or failure promises
Semantic relevance in search is judged by the read-only search AI reading the ToC
Skills run in the caller context; only the information-generating AI is separated into another context
Scripts reject disallowed transitions by checking versions and state, not self-reported prior success
The internal tolerance limit H is never disclosed to the information-generating AI
Impact candidates are enumerated mechanically; no fix judgments are made inside doc-link
Partial DLID-assignment failures keep already-written IDs and report per-document problems
All files stay inside the project; temporary files go under .temp/doc-link/<skill>/
Managed state is stored as deterministic JSON in .doc-link/: one file per document ID and one per ToC key
tasks: Designing or changing responsibility boundaries between AI, Skills, and scripts
Implementing doc-link scripts and their operations
Writing or modifying SKILL.md and custom Agent definitions
Implementing DLID assignment and its failure handling
Designing managed-state storage and merge behavior
title: DES-002 実行主体と処理責務
